messages:
maria-docs: Heads-up — I ran through the quickstart today and hit a confusing copy/paste issue in the README curl + Node examples. The curl example shows an env var named REDWOOD_KEY but our SDKs expect REDWOOD_API_KEY. Users keep opening issues.

kai-engineer: oof. which file?

maria-docs: docs/quickstart/README.md — top code block. Also the Node sample mixes `fetch` usage that only works in newer Node versions; people paste it into older apps and get `fetch is not defined`.

emma-devex: can we make the snippets explicit and platform-aware? eg two curl variants and a Node snippet that uses node-fetch import or top-level await note. Small change but reduces a ton of friction.

sanjay-eng: agreed. while we're at it: the curl example uses `-H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"` — change to `$REDWOOD_API_KEY` and add a one-liner about Windows Powershell escaping.

maria-docs: I sketched a minimal fix in a branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478 — updated env var name, added a PowerShell example, and swapped Node snippet to a compatibility-safe variant.

ekai-engineer: nice. can you paste the new Node snippet here so I can sanity-check?

maria-docs: sure:

```js
// Node (v14+) compatible example
const fetch = require('node-fetch'); // note: install node-fetch@2 for commonjs
const API_KEY = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY;

fetch('https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${API_KEY}`
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'Hello' })
})
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(console.log)
  .catch(err => console.error('Fetch failed', err));
```

emma-devex: this looks good. also add a tiny note about retries: our SDKs do exponential backoff by default but curl examples shouldn't imply automatic retries. add a brief line.

sanjay-eng: can we also add copy buttons to code blocks? those have helped reduce bad pastes.

maria-docs: opened PR w/ changes + a docs-automation ticket to add copy buttons: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478 and #392 (docs-ui).

deploy-bot: docs site rebuild queued (job 8842). ETA ~ 10m.

emma-devex: great. follow-up: once merged, let's toss a quick note into onboarding checklist so solutions engineers know to reference the updated snippet when walking new customers through a curl test.

kai-engineer: will do — I'll add the checklist item. thanks y'all :thumbsup:

maria-docs: thanks — closing the thread once PR merges.
